## 6. Design options (WP4.3.e)

### A: skin-dominated

Thick, tapered skins carry the bending; few, light stringers (pitch 0.25 m) only for panel stability later in WP5. Simple to build and inspect, few parts, but skin panels between stringers are wide.

### B: stringer-dominated

Thin skins, many heavy stringers at a small pitch (0.12 m). Material is concentrated in the stringers; small panels are good for skin buckling (WP5), but many parts and fasteners.

### C: spar-dominated, 3-spar inboard

Strong spars with heavy spar caps take the bending; a third spar at 0.45c out to eta = 0.40 (just outboard of the engine at eta = 0.35) makes the inboard box two-cell (torsion, web shear, fail-safe). Thin skins, few light stringers (pitch 0.20 m).
